summary: The analysis meets quality standards and is ready for the next phase. It correctly identifies both core problems (per-push granularity and Claude Code JSONL dependency), demonstrates thorough codebase research with specific file/line references, presents four meaningfully different options with clear trade-offs, identifies technical constraints and dependencies, raises actionable open questions with recommendations, and provides a well-justified recommendation for Option B (API Proxy Instrumentation + Ring Buffer) with a phased implementation plan.
